item.title: security: ​​​​​​What’s new in Microsoft Security: August 2026
item.description:
August 2026 Microsoft Security updates add capabilities for monitoring agent activity, broaden security coverage across supported environments, and improve security management across environments. The post is a high-level roundup and does not list specific product changes in the provided excerpt.

  • Source: Microsoft Security Blog

item.title: commandline: One requirement, many failure paths: Evaluate, control, and optimize with ASSERT and ACS
item.description:
The article says a safety requirement can have a complex runtime failure surface even when it seems simple. It highlights ASSERT for finding coverage bugs and ACS for fixing the policy.

  • Source: Microsoft Command Line Blog
